title: Story Bible
description: Canonical narrative reference (production/story/story-bible.yaml). Bibles outrank prompts: facts recorded here are the source of truth for every downstream artifact.

logline.description: One-sentence statement of protagonist, goal, and obstacle.

synopsis.description: One-paragraph to one-page prose summary of the full story.

themes.description: Thematic threads the film argues (e.g. guilt, escape).

tone.description: Emotional register and genre feel (e.g. rain-slick neon noir).

acts.description: Act structure; each act breaks into sequences, each sequence lists its scenes.

scenes.description: Scene IDs covered by this sequence, in story order.

canon_facts.description: Immutable-once-approved facts every agent must respect. Contradicting a canon fact is a validation failure, not a creative choice.

category.description: What kind of canon this fact constrains.

established_in.description: Scene where the fact is first established on screen, if any.

immutable.description: True once approved; changing it requires a new story-bible revision.

characters.description: Index of character IDs with bibles under production/characters/.

locations.description: Index of location IDs with bibles under production/locations/.

notes.description: Open questions and working notes; not canon.
